summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend test of Project AI Hardened Core v1 scanner. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (all 5 scan endpoints + history CRUD). Frontend: all 5 module tiles, tab bar, and each scan-to-results flow (text MEDIUM, photo HIGH, profile ELEVATED, phone mismatch, full-scan empty LOW) verified on mobile viewport. Archive tab shows persisted history, opens item, clear works.

issues: Console shows 4x 404 resource errors on every navigation (likely favicon / static asset). Non-blocking but should be traced.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents (repeated on each screen).

action_items: (Optional) migrate any remaining pointerEvents prop usages to style.pointerEvents to silence deprecation warnings.
(Optional) investigate the 4x 404 asset requests seen in browser console on each screen (probably favicon/manifest).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id (uses projection {"_id": 0}) — verified in list/get endpoints.
project_ai_core.py stays under 400 lines, uses Pydantic for input validation, no hardcoded secrets.
Phone results screen maps advisory flags to MEDIUM hero color which is reasonable but note: request wording said 'valid=true with mismatch flag' — flag is surfaced correctly. Not a bug.

Doc/testID mismatch: review request referenced generic testIDs like profile-followers/phone-number but actual app uses profile-input-follower_count / phone-input-number / phone-input-claimed. Tests adjusted accordingly.
seed_data_creation: test_history_crud writes and cleans up scan records prefixed with TEST_ input_summary. Archive tab UI test creates 4 scans (text/photo/profile/full) which remain unless cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Actual profile field testIDs are profile-input-follower_count, profile-input-following_count, profile-input-post_count, profile-input-photo_count, profile-input-account_age_days, profile-input-bio, profile-contacted-first. Phone field testIDs are phone-input-number, phone-input-claimed, phone-region. Frontend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Backend engine name must remain 'Project AI Hardened Core v1'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found. All fixtures produced expected verdicts.
